newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom has more mobile projects.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom has more mobile projects.

text.p: France Telecom is eyeing mobile telecommunications projects in Moldova, Brazil, Morocco and the Netherlands in the next stages of international expansion, Jean-Baptiste de Boissiere said on Thursday.
De Boissiere, chairman of France Telecom Mobile International (FTMI), was speaking in a telephone conference on the eve of his unit winning a licence in Denmark.
De Boissiere said the Moldova licence would be an extension of France Telecom's operations in neighbouring Romania.
In Brazil, there will be a tender on April 7 for a "giant" licence for the so-called Band B.
This will be a selection of either TDMA or CDMA technology with France Telecom offering a CDMA solution.
In Morocco, France Telecom aims to tender for a GSM licence but the Moroccan parliament has not yet approved the legal framework for the tender.
In the Netherlands, France Telecom has teamed up with Rabobank for a DCS-1800 digital network. There too it will have to wait for parliamentary approval.
De Boissiere said that FTMI had not been given a global authorisation for investments by the France Telecom board but had to obtain project-by-project board approval.
